items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractCachingConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableCaching.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类上EnableCaching.mode()的值，选择应使用的AbstractCachingConfiguration实现。

items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractAsyncConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableAsync.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类上EnableAsync.mode()的值，选择应使用的AbstractAsyncConfiguration实现。

items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableTransactionManagement.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 选择要使用的AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration实现，该实现基于导入的@Configuration类上EnableTransactionManagement.mode()的值。
